items.headline: 3M Open Cut Hits Big Names
items.text: The 3M Open cut line hit 2-under, sending home Tony Finau, Max Homa, Sungjae Im, Nick Dunlap, and Matt Kuchar, while Patton Kizzire withdrew after a 77 opening round.

items.headline: DeChambeau Roasts LIV Teammate
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau poked fun at LIV teammate Paul Casey for leading Round 2 in driving distance at LIV Golf UK during their team competition.
